state.limitations: The source-freshness interface has no production implementation. Both target and operation source reads use the certificate only if a future provider supplies it. An uncertain claim or unresolved later seed generation remains pending. The no-op outcome is not implemented; the claim only fixes identity.

duplicate_facts.instructions: Can repeated exact human claim retries append a second claim event?

fresh_generation.instructions: Should a valid newly authorized generation by itself make an otherwise identical operation identity a different authored intent?

cross_kind.instructions: Can a structural intent and a summary intent both claim the same scoped operation ID?

seed_human.instructions: Can the exact same scoped operation ID be committed both as a human claim and as a trusted seed claim?

seed_generation.instructions: Does reusing an immutable seed claim by itself prove a later execution generation is valid?

conflict_before_auth.instructions: Does the service disclose a previously claimed different intent before current operator admission succeeds?

changed_before_preflight.instructions: Does it inspect the authorized operation identity for changed intent before returning a target-state preflight refusal?

existing_pending.instructions: After an exact claim exists, does a target preflight refusal become a durable terminal refusal?

invalid_claim.instructions: Should an invalid point of focus missing parent identity create an operation claim?

unqualified_claim.instructions: Can target mutation proceed when exact claim source currentness cannot be qualified?

unknown_append.instructions: Does a lost claim append acknowledgement establish that the claim was not committed?

claim_is_outcome.instructions: Does the immutable claim itself prove the target change or no-op was accepted?

old_target_rebase.instructions: Can a target executor transparently rebase a previously admitted operation after its observed target source position changed?

unbounded_roster.instructions: Does this owner retain a roster of historical operation attempts or criteria children?

provider_proven.instructions: Do these implementations prove that the deployed provider can certify a fresh source head?

absent_race.instructions: Does observing no operation claim rule out a concurrent same-ID claim immediately after the source read?
